Perhaps the issue is that the player "Player Tester" at (3,7) is blocking me to the right, and the notice board blocks... but up/down/left should work. Let me check the map again — (2,6) is '.', (2,8) is '.', (1,7) is '.'. All walkable. Yet I can't move.

Maybe there's a menu/panel open that's capturing input. Let me try pressing a cancel/escape-like button. Let me check body_controls again — only WASD, E, C. 

Let me try pressing C (craft) — maybe a menu is open.
